item.title: Hubble 1.1.5
item.description:
Hubble 1.1.5
Hubble 1.1.5: Keep the spreadsheet responsive during saves
- Reverse action expansion immediately, even while earlier changes are still saving. - Keep typing and column resizing available while expansion changes save in the background, and retain edits made during those saves. - Keep the latest expand or collapse choice visible as queued saves finish. - Preserve action buttons, resize handles, and keyboard focus through background spreadsheet refreshes.
